fact: Car 27 allegedly causing a collision, and touched wheels with Car 10 at exit of T5.
offence: Alleged breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV Art 2(d) of the International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards reviewed video evidence including in-car video. The Stewards determined that this was an incident resulting from close racing with no sporting consequences and that no driver was wholly or predominantly at fault.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Decision Car 27 Alleged Causing A Collision
to: The Team Manager, Kick Sauber F1 Team
